rows.name: Backpack, Masterwork
rows.description: A masterwork backpack with numerous pockets, hooks, and padded straps; treats the wearer's Strength as 1 higher for carrying-capacity purposes only.

rows.name: Barbed Vest
rows.description: A black vest lined with hundreds of tiny fishhook-like needles; anyone striking the wearer with a natural or unarmed attack takes 1 point of damage unless they make a Reflex save. Worn only over light armor.

rows.name: Blanket
rows.description: A warm, woven blanket with straps so it can be rolled up and tied for carrying.

rows.name: Buoy, Common
rows.description: A float used to mark a specific spot in a lake or river; includes 200 feet of twine and a 15-pound anchor stone.

rows.name: Buoy (Superior)
rows.description: A spherical or ovoid hollow metal float, typically copper, connected to a length of chain and a metal anchor rather than twine and a stone.

rows.name: Butterfly Net
rows.description: A 6-foot pole supporting a wide metal hoop covered by a thin mesh net, used to sift small objects or capture Fine or Diminutive creatures.

rows.name: Chalkboard
rows.description: A wooden frame surrounding a thinly sliced piece of polished black stone; rubbing a damp cloth over the slate erases anything written on it.

rows.name: Chest, Small
rows.description: A small lockable storage chest: 2 cubic feet capacity, 1 hit point, break DC 17.

rows.name: Chest, Medium
rows.description: A medium lockable storage chest: 4 cubic feet capacity, 15 hit points, break DC 23.

rows.name: Chest, Large
rows.description: A large lockable storage chest: 6 cubic feet capacity, 30 hit points, break DC 29.

rows.name: Chest, Huge
rows.description: A huge lockable storage chest: 8 cubic feet capacity, 50 hit points, break DC 35.

rows.name: Earplugs
rows.description: Waxed cotton or cork earplugs granting a +2 circumstance bonus on saves against hearing-based effects, at the cost of a -5 penalty on hearing-based Perception checks.

rows.name: Hourglass, 1 hour
rows.description: An hourglass that measures one hour of elapsed time.

rows.name: Hourglass, 1 minute
rows.description: An hourglass that measures one minute of elapsed time.

rows.name: Hourglass, 6 seconds
rows.description: An hourglass that measures six seconds of elapsed time (one combat round).

rows.name: Iron Spike
rows.description: A foot-long iron spike used to keep doors open or closed and to secure ropes for climbing; a DC 5 Perception check detects the sound of one being driven in.

rows.name: Magnet
rows.description: A hand-sized horseshoe magnet that can lift up to 3 pounds of iron; mainly used to detect or retrieve iron, mithral, or adamantine objects.

rows.name: Marbles
rows.description: A 2-pound bag of marbles covering a 5-foot square; a creature entering the area must succeed at a DC 10 Reflex save or fall prone.

rows.name: Periscope
rows.description: A 2-foot metal tube with mirrors at right angles at each end, letting the user safely peer over an obstacle at the cost of a -4 Perception penalty while in use.

rows.name: Ring, Poison Pill
rows.description: A ring with a tiny hidden compartment under the setting, typically used to conceal poison; opening or closing the compartment is a move action.

rows.name: Powder
rows.description: Powdered chalk, flour, or similar material that, thrown into a square, can momentarily reveal an invisible creature there, or be spread on a surface to reveal footprints.

rows.name: Rice Paper, Sheet
rows.description: A sheet of paper made from rice or tree bark; hardness 0, 1 hit point, break DC 2.

rows.name: Rope, Spider Silk (50 ft.)
rows.description: Fifty feet of rope woven from monstrous spider silk by goblin slaves; has 6 hit points and requires a DC 25 Strength check to burst.

rows.name: Signal Horn
rows.description: A horn that, when sounded with a DC 10 Perform (wind instruments) check, can convey simple prearranged messages such as "Attack!" or "Help!" audible up to half a mile away.

rows.name: Smoked Goggles
rows.description: Spectacles with lenses of smoked glass that treat the wearer as always averting their gaze against gaze attacks, at the cost of a -4 Perception penalty and granting onlookers 20% concealment.

rows.name: String (50 ft.)
rows.description: Fifty feet of string, sold in a ball or spool; hardness 0, 1 hit point, break DC 14. Useful for traps and alarms.

rows.name: Swarmsuit
rows.description: Heavy, overlapping layers of clothing and a veiled wide-brimmed hat that grant damage reduction against swarms of Fine or Diminutive creatures, at the cost of halved speed.

rows.name: Medium Tent
rows.description: A tent holding two Medium creatures, taking 30 minutes to assemble.

rows.name: Large Tent
rows.description: A tent holding four Medium creatures, taking 45 minutes to assemble.

rows.name: Pavilion
rows.description: A large pavilion tent holding ten Medium creatures and taking 90 minutes to assemble; roomy enough for a small fire inside.

rows.name: Twine (50 ft.)
rows.description: Fifty feet of twine, sold in a ball or spool; hardness 0, 1 hit point, break DC 14. Useful for traps and alarms.

rows.name: Weapon Cord
rows.description: A leather strap attaching a weapon to the wielder's wrist; a dropped weapon can be recovered as a swift action, and cutting the cord is a move action (or an attack against it).

rows.name: Whistle, Signal
rows.description: A whistle that, with a DC 5 Perform (wind instruments) check, can convey simple prearranged messages, audible up to a quarter mile away.

rows.name: Whistle, Silent
rows.description: A whistle pitched so only animals and creatures with keen hearing can perceive it.

rows.name: Alchemical Grease
rows.description: A slick black goo, one pot of which covers one Medium or two Small creatures, granting a +5 alchemical bonus on Escape Artist checks and grapple-related checks for 4 hours.

rows.name: Alchemical Solvent (Vial)
rows.description: A bubbling purple gel that eats through adhesives over a 5-foot square, destroying normal adhesives in 1 round and powerful adhesives in 1d4+1 rounds; has no effect on magical adhesives.

rows.name: Alchemist's Kindness
rows.description: A crystalline powder resembling salt that, mixed with water, produces a fizzing drink that eliminates the effects of a hangover within 10 minutes.

rows.name: Alkali (Flask)
rows.description: A flask of caustic liquid that reacts with an ooze's natural acids, dealing double splash-weapon damage against oozes and normal damage against other targets.

rows.name: Antiplague (Vial)
rows.description: A foul-tasting, milky tonic granting a +5 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves against disease for 1 hour; a creature already infected may reroll its save that day using the better result.

rows.name: Bladeguard
rows.description: A clear resin that, coated on a weapon or ammunition, renders it immune to attacks that damage weapons (such as those from oozes or rust monsters) for 24 hours.

rows.name: Bloodblock
rows.description: A gooey, pinkish substance that grants a +5 alchemical bonus on Heal checks to treat wounds and can end an ongoing bleed effect with a DC 15 Heal check.

rows.name: Casting Plaster
rows.description: A white, dry powder that, mixed with water, forms a paste that hardens in one hour; used to make casts of footprints, fill gaps, or create medical splints.

rows.name: Flash Powder
rows.description: A coarse gray powder that, ignited as a standard action, blinds creatures within a 10-foot-radius burst for 1 round unless they succeed at a DC 13 Fortitude save.

rows.name: Light Detector
rows.description: A hand-sized metal plate covered in light-sensitive paste that darkens at different rates depending on ambient light level, used to detect recent illumination.

rows.name: Liquid Ice (Flask)
rows.description: A sealed jar of crystalline blue fluid that evaporates once opened, freezing liquids or coating objects over 1d6 rounds; can also be thrown as a splash weapon dealing cold damage.

rows.name: Nushadir (Vial)
rows.description: Small salty pellets that, mixed with water, safely neutralize a cubic foot of acid within a minute, though the vapors can cause nausea.

rows.name: Smelling Salts
rows.description: Sharply scented gray crystals that let an unconscious creature attempt a new save against the effect that felled it, or grant momentary consciousness to a dying creature.

rows.name: Smoke Pellet
rows.description: A small clay sphere containing two alchemical substances that, thrown as a ranged touch attack, breaks to fill a 5-foot square with yellow smoke for 1 round.

rows.name: Sneezing Powder (Pouch)
rows.description: A coarse yellowish-red powder splash weapon that causes uncontrollable sneezing for 1d4+1 rounds in creatures that fail a Fortitude save.

rows.name: Soothe Syrup
rows.description: A sweet, wholesome-tasting blue liquid granting a +5 alchemical bonus on saves against nausea and sickened effects for 1 hour after drinking.

rows.name: Adamantine Weapon Blanch
rows.description: An alchemical powder that, melted onto a weapon or ammunition over a flame, lets the coated attack bypass adamantine damage reduction on its first successful hit.

rows.name: Cold Iron Weapon Blanch
rows.description: An alchemical powder that, melted onto a weapon or ammunition over a flame, lets the coated attack bypass cold iron damage reduction on its first successful hit.

rows.name: Silver Weapon Blanch
rows.description: An alchemical powder that, melted onto a weapon or ammunition over a flame, lets the coated attack bypass silver damage reduction on its first successful hit.

rows.name: Abacus
rows.description: A simple mechanical device that helps its user perform mathematical calculations.

rows.name: Alchemist's Kit
rows.description: A kit assumed to include all the material components an alchemist needs for extracts, mutagens, and bombs, except components with a specific listed cost.

rows.name: Alchemist's Lab, Portable
rows.description: A compact version of a full-size alchemist's lab, granting a +1 circumstance bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

rows.name: Anvil (Blacksmith)
rows.description: A 100-pound blacksmith's anvil, needed for most metalworking Craft tasks.

rows.name: Anvil (Farrier)
rows.description: A 50-pound farrier's anvil, sized for shoeing work rather than general blacksmithing.

rows.name: Anvil (Goldsmith/Silversmith)
rows.description: A 10-pound goldsmith's or silversmith's anvil, sized for fine metalworking.

rows.name: Astrolabe
rows.description: A flat disc with two smaller discs mounted on a central axis; lets its user determine the date and time at night in about a minute, and grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Knowledge (geography), Survival navigation, and Profession (sailor) checks.

rows.name: Balancing Pole
rows.description: A flexible 15-to-30-foot pole that grants a +1 circumstance bonus on Acrobatics checks made to balance on narrow surfaces.

rows.name: Bear Trap
rows.description: A hinged-jaw trap chained to a ground spike; a captured creature must succeed at a DC 20 Strength check to pry it open or pull the spike free.

rows.name: Bellows
rows.description: A tool useful for starting fires, granting a +1 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to do so.

rows.name: Cauldron
rows.description: An iron pot, sometimes fitted with a hook for hanging over a fire, holding about a gallon; used for cooking and for brewing potions.

rows.name: Compass
rows.description: An ordinary compass pointing to magnetic north; grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Survival checks to avoid getting lost and on Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks for underground navigation.

rows.name: Drill
rows.description: A hand tool that can bore a 1-inch-diameter hole in stone, wood, or metal as a standard action; a DC 15 Perception check detects the sound of its use.

rows.name: Footprint Book
rows.description: A 50-page tome of accurate drawings of common animal, humanoid, and monster tracks with notes on stride and tread, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to identify a creature from its tracks.

rows.name: Fortune-Teller's Deck (Common)
rows.description: A simple deck of illustrated fortune-telling cards drawn on parchment or wooden plaques.

rows.name: Fortune-Teller's Deck (Quality)
rows.description: A quality deck of fortune-telling cards on painted wooden plaques, suitable as an augury spell focus and granting a +1 circumstance bonus on related Profession checks.

rows.name: Fortune-Teller's Deck (Masterwork)
rows.description: A masterwork fortune-telling deck of wood, ivory, or metal with painted or carved images, suitable as an augury spell focus and granting a +2 circumstance bonus on related Profession checks.

rows.name: Leeching Kit
rows.description: A ceramic jar half-filled with water containing four 6-inch leeches, granting a +2 circumstance bonus on Heal checks to treat poison; a leech can survive six months between feedings.

rows.name: Map Maker's Kit
rows.description: A small kit with a gridded slate and colored chalk, granting a +2 circumstance bonus on Survival checks to avoid getting lost while mapping.

rows.name: Portrait Book
rows.description: A 100-page book of face drawings for various humanoid races, used to help create a likeness for a portrait or wanted poster.

rows.name: Pulley
rows.description: A simple block-and-tackle pulley that, once secured, grants a +5 circumstance bonus on Strength checks to lift heavy objects.

rows.name: Saw
rows.description: A hand saw; inserted between a door and its frame it can cut through wooden bolts or bars, dealing 5 hit points of damage plus the user's Strength modifier as a full-round action.

rows.name: Sextant
rows.description: A navigational instrument used to determine latitude, granting a +4 circumstance bonus on Survival checks to navigate above ground.

rows.name: Symptom Kit
rows.description: A small compartmented box of items for feigning illness (false pustules, mouth-foaming pills, fever-inducing herbs) plus a reference book on diseases, granting a +5 bonus on Disguise checks simulating sickness.

rows.name: Traveling Spellbook
rows.description: A lighter, less cumbersome 50-page blank spellbook than a full-size spellbook.

rows.name: Cleats
rows.description: Shoes fitted with spikes or hooks that reduce the movement penalty on slick surfaces by half, at the cost of damaging finished flooring.

rows.name: Furs
rows.description: The most basic cold-weather gear; animal furs grant a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against cold weather (does not stack with the Survival skill's own bonus).

rows.name: Hot Weather Outfit
rows.description: A loose linen robe with a turban or head covering and veil, granting a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against hot weather (does not stack with the Survival skill's own bonus).

rows.name: Snowshoes
rows.description: High-tension nets of rope or sinew in wooden frames, lashed to the feet to reduce the movement penalty in heavy snow by half.

rows.name: Animal Harness
rows.description: A leather or hemp harness that lets its holder restrain and control a domesticated animal; ready-made for common animals, with custom harnesses available for others.

rows.name: Cage (Diminutive or Fine)
rows.description: A secure, portable enclosure for holding a Diminutive or Fine creature.

rows.name: Cage (Huge)
rows.description: A secure, portable enclosure for holding a Huge creature.

rows.name: Cage (Large)
rows.description: A secure, portable enclosure for holding a Large creature.

rows.name: Cage (Small or Medium)
rows.description: A secure, portable enclosure for holding a Small or Medium creature.

rows.name: Cage (Tiny)
rows.description: A secure, portable enclosure for holding a Tiny creature.

rows.name: Dog Sled
rows.description: A sled several feet long, designed to be pulled over snow and ice by a team of trained riding dogs; most have runners for a musher and carry cargo up to the dogs' combined capacity.

rows.name: Loaded Dice, Average
rows.description: Dice weighted with a heavier substance opposite the desired number; a DC 15 Appraise or Perception check is needed to spot the tampering.

rows.name: Loaded Dice, Superior
rows.description: Higher-quality loaded dice carved around a naturally heavy inclusion, requiring a DC 20 to 30 check to detect.

rows.name: Marked Cards
rows.description: A deck of cards bent, colored, or scratched so an informed user can tell front from back; a DC 25 Perception check is needed to notice the marking.

rows.name: Arrow, Blunt (20)
rows.description: A bundle of 20 blunted wooden-tipped arrows that deal bludgeoning damage instead of piercing damage.

rows.name: Arrow, Flight (20)
rows.description: A bundle of 20 arrows with light shafts and special fletching, granting 20 extra feet of range on a longbow (10 feet on a shortbow) but dealing damage as though one size category smaller.

rows.name: Arrow, Smoke (20)
rows.description: A bundle of 20 specially shaped smokestick arrows that trail smoke in flight and create a 5-foot cube of smoke where they strike.

rows.name: Arrow, Blunt
rows.description: A single blunted wooden-tipped arrow that deals bludgeoning damage instead of piercing damage.

rows.name: Arrow, Flight
rows.description: A single arrow with a light shaft and special fletching, granting extra range but dealing damage as though one size category smaller.

rows.name: Arrow, Smoke
rows.description: A single specially shaped smokestick arrow that trails smoke in flight and creates a 5-foot cube of smoke where it strikes.

rows.name: Arrow, Searing
rows.description: A +1 flaming arrow that continues to burn its target for 1d6 points of fire damage each round for three rounds after a hit; removing it requires a DC 10 Heal check (DC 15 to remove from oneself).

rows.name: Bolt, Tangle
rows.description: A +1 seeking crossbow bolt etched with webs and vines that becomes a sticky mass on impact, entangling the target like a tanglefoot bag.

rows.name: Bullet, Dustburst
rows.description: A +1 sling bullet that explodes into a 5-foot cube of choking dust following the target for 1d6 rounds; a creature ending its turn there must save or become sickened and blinded for 1 round.

rows.name: Quilted Cloth
rows.description: An enhanced form of padded armor with internal layers designed to trap incoming projectiles, granting DR 3/- against small ranged piercing weapons only.

rows.name: Wooden
rows.description: Leather armor reinforced with plates of fire-treated wood over vital areas; slightly buoyant, reducing its swim armor check penalty to 0.

rows.name: Armored Coat
rows.description: A sturdy leather coat reinforced with metal plates sewn into the lining; can be donned or removed as a move action, and layers over other armor for better AC at the cost of worse armor check penalties.

rows.name: Agile Breastplate
rows.description: A breastplate crafted for extra maneuverability, reducing the usual armor check penalty on Climb and Jump checks to only -1 instead of -4.

rows.name: Agile Half-Plate
rows.description: A half-plate crafted for extra maneuverability, reducing the usual armor check penalty on Climb and Jump checks to -4, and letting the wearer run at quadruple speed as though wearing light armor.

rows.name: Armor of Insults
rows.description: A +1 studded leather that can force hostile creatures within 60 feet to attack its wearer for several rounds unless they succeed at a Will save.

rows.name: Boneless Leather
rows.description: A +1 leather armor granting a +5 bonus on Escape Artist and Acrobatics checks, a +5 bonus to CMD, and DR 5/piercing or slashing.

rows.name: Buccaneer's Breastplate
rows.description: A +1 breastplate that grants the wearer a continuous water walk effect.

rows.name: Daystar Half-Plate
rows.description: A +1 half-plate that provides an at-will daylight effect and, once per day, a sunburst effect.

rows.name: Folding Plate
rows.description: A +1 full plate armor that can transform between a wearable brooch and its full armor form on command.

rows.name: Forsaken Banded Mail
rows.description: A +1 banded mail that prevents its wearer from casting divine spells but grants spell resistance against divine abilities and treats its enhancement bonus as 2 higher against divine creatures.

rows.name: [NAME]-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into the matching giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a hill giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a stone giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a fire giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a frost giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME]-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a troll's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a cloud giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: [NAME] Giant-hide
rows.description: A +3 hide armor that lets the wearer transform, once per day, into a storm giant's form for up to 15 minutes.

rows.name: Mistmail
rows.description: A +1 chain shirt that can transform into a concealing fog once per day.

rows.name: Murderer's Blackcloth
rows.description: A +1 shadow padded armor that increases a wearing rogue's sneak attack bleed damage by 1.

rows.name: Soothsayer's Raiment (Battlecry)
rows.description: A +1 chainmail granting the wearer oracle spellcasting access to the Battle mystery's Battlecry revelation, plus a +5 bonus on the wearer's divination spell success.

rows.name: Soothsayer's Raiment (Battlefield Clarity)
rows.description: A +1 chainmail granting the wearer oracle spellcasting access to the Battle mystery's Battlefield Clarity revelation, plus a +5 bonus on the wearer's divination spell success.

rows.name: Battlement Shield
rows.description: A +2 tower shield that can transform, once per day, into a 10-by-10-by-1-foot masonry wall with battlements.

rows.name: Fortress Shield
rows.description: A +1 tower shield that can create a sealed iron cube providing total cover, requiring occupants to hold their breath after the third round.

rows.name: Quickdraw Shield, Light Wooden
rows.description: A light wooden shield fitted with straps letting a wielder with base attack bonus +1 or higher ready or stow it as a swift action; Quick Draw allows it as a free action.

rows.name: Quickdraw Shield, Light Steel
rows.description: A light steel shield fitted with straps letting a wielder with base attack bonus +1 or higher ready or stow it as a swift action; Quick Draw allows it as a free action.

rows.name: Battle Aspergillum
rows.description: A light mace with a hollow head and a metal plug that sprinkles holy water on a successful hit, dealing 1 extra point of damage per hit up to five times.

rows.name: Cestus
rows.description: A leather or thick-cloth glove reinforced with metal plates, covering mid-finger to mid-forearm; deals bludgeoning or piercing damage, at a -2 penalty on tasks requiring precision with that hand.

rows.name: Wooden Stake
rows.description: A sharpened piece of wood; an iron spike used as a weapon deals this same damage.

rows.name: Bayonet
rows.description: A close-combat blade designed to fit into the grooves or muzzle of a crossbow or firearm; attaching or removing it is a move action.

rows.name: Boar Spear
rows.description: A spiral-bladed spear with a metal crossbar about halfway down its length; readying it against a charge grants a +2 shield bonus to AC.

rows.name: Sword Cane
rows.description: A slender light blade concealed within a wooden container serving as both scabbard and hiding place; drawing it is a swift action, and a DC 20 Perception check (DC 10 if handled) is needed to identify it as a weapon.

rows.name: Bardiche
rows.description: A polearm with a long, heavy cutting blade mounted on a pole.

rows.name: Bec de Corbin
rows.description: A polearm similar to a lucerne hammer but with a blunt head, granting a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to sunder medium or heavy armor.

rows.name: Bill
rows.description: A polearm with a curved or hooked cutting blade and a spiked rear projection; grants a +1 shield bonus to AC when fighting defensively, and imposes a Ride penalty on mounted opponents struck by it.

rows.name: Glaive-Guisarme
rows.description: A polearm combining a glaive's blade with a hook, imposing an extra Ride penalty on mounted opponents struck by it.

rows.name: Lucerne Hammer
rows.description: A polearm with a pronged hammer head for crushing blows and a spiked head for piercing, granting a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to sunder armor.

rows.name: Swordbreaker Dagger
rows.description: A dagger with notched grooves designed to catch and disarm or sunder a bladed weapon, granting a +4 bonus on disarm or sunder attempts against bladed weapons for a proficient wielder.

rows.name: Falcata
rows.description: A heavy blade with a single sharp, concave edge and a hook-shaped hilt, balancing an axe's weight distribution with a sword's cutting edge.

rows.name: Khopesh
rows.description: A heavy blade with a convex curve near its tip, giving it an overall shape similar to a battleaxe.

rows.name: Temple Sword
rows.description: A heavy blade favored by guardians of religious sites, with a crescent-shaped edge resembling a hybrid of a sickle and sword; monks are proficient with it.

rows.name: Chain Spear
rows.description: A short thrusting spear whose butt is fitted with a length of chain, often spiked and hooked, usable to make trip attacks.

rows.name: Mancatcher
rows.description: A polearm with two curved metal bands, sized for a specific creature size category, that close around a target on a successful touch attack followed by a grapple check.

rows.name: Spirit Blade
rows.description: A +3 ghost touch dagger with a translucent blade decorated with faces and mist; can cast dispel magic once per day.

rows.name: Beaststrike Club
rows.description: A +1 club that a wild shape user can expend a daily use to transform into a natural weapon form (bite, claw, gore, slam, sting, or talon), counting as both a natural and a manufactured weapon.

rows.name: Mace, Boulderhead
rows.description: A +1 heavy mace that, once per day, releases a Large boulder rolling 60 feet and dealing 3d8+5 damage (Reflex DC 19 half), leaving difficult terrain that regrows over 24 hours.

rows.name: Guarding Blade
rows.description: A +1 dancing short sword that automatically defends an unconscious or sleeping wielder, attacking nearby enemies for several rounds before dropping back into the wielder's square.

rows.name: Hammer, Ricochet
rows.description: A +1 returning light hammer that ricochets between multiple targets using the wielder's extra base-attack-bonus attacks, with cumulative range penalties on each bounce.

rows.name: Starknife, Sparkwake
rows.description: A +1 shock starknife that leaves trails of sparks in flight; once per day it can transform into an 8d6 lightning bolt (Reflex DC 14 half) before returning to its physical form.

rows.name: Undercutting Axe
rows.description: A +1 giant-bane battleaxe that, after a successful hit, can invoke a maximized ray of enfeeblement once per day against the struck creature.

rows.name: Trident of Stability
rows.description: A +1 trident fitted with a footrest bar that functions as an immovable rod when stepped on, granting a large CMD bonus and halting falls.

rows.name: Blade of Binding
rows.description: A +1 greatsword that enables free grapple attempts on a successful hit; the blade transforms into a chain that wraps around the target (Escape Artist DC 20, break DC 28, hardness 10, 10 hit points).

rows.name: Lance of Jousting
rows.description: A +1 ornate lance that forces a mounted opponent struck by it to make a Ride check (DC 10 plus damage dealt) or be knocked from the saddle.

rows.name: Shieldsplitter Lance
rows.description: A +1 keen lance that can penetrate shields, dealing shield damage on a hit and bypassing hardness during sunder attempts against a shielded opponent.

rows.name: Buffoon's Sword
rows.description: A cursed blade that behaves like a sword of subtlety until used in combat, at which point it imposes a -10 penalty on Stealth checks and forces the wielder to blurt out the truth unless a DC 15 Will save succeeds.

rows.name: Chakram
rows.description: A flat, open-centered metal discus with a sharpened edge; using it in melee imposes a -1 penalty and risks a DC 15 Reflex save to avoid cutting yourself.

rows.name: Pilum
rows.description: A heavy javelin designed to break and embed itself in a shield on a hit, denying the shield's AC bonus until the wielder spends a standard action prying it free.

rows.name: Boomerang
rows.description: A flat, curved wooden thrown weapon that does not return to the thrower.

rows.name: Crossbow, [NAME]
rows.description: A heavy crossbow that fires a pair of iron-tipped bolts with a single trigger pull; imposes a -4 penalty if proficient (-8 if not), and only the first bolt can score a critical hit or sneak attack.

rows.name: Brass Knuckles
rows.description: A close-combat weapon fitted around the knuckles, dealing lethal unarmed damage; a monk using them deals monk unarmed damage.

rows.name: Improvised Weapon, Light
rows.description: A light object not designed as a weapon but pressed into service as one, following the normal improvised weapon rules.

rows.name: Improvised Weapon, One-Handed
rows.description: A one-handed object not designed as a weapon but pressed into service as one, following the normal improvised weapon rules.

rows.name: Improvised Weapon, Two-Handed
rows.description: A two-handed object not designed as a weapon but pressed into service as one, following the normal improvised weapon rules.

rows.name: Beacon of True Faith
rows.description: An ornate electrum torch bearing an undying magical flame; it functions as an everburning torch for most creatures, but grants alignment-based powers to divine spellcasters and faithful creatures.

rows.name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
rows.description: A +3 Large returning warhammer; when wielded alongside a belt of giant strength by someone who knows its true nature, it becomes a +5 giant-bane thundering hammer with a thunderclap ability.

rows.name: Knucklebone of Fickle Fortune
rows.description: A piece of bone worn down to a near sphere, resembling a twenty-sided die, that produces random effects ranging from permanent negative levels to resurrection when rolled.

rows.name: Perfect Golden Lute
rows.description: A flawless golden lute granting a +10 competence bonus on Perform checks and extending bardic performance abilities to those with appropriate ranks.

rows.name: Spindle of Perfect Knowledge
rows.description: A flawless marquise-cut diamond ioun stone that functions as a +4 headband of mental superiority, granting five ranks in two random Knowledge skills and language comprehension.

rows.name: Talisman of Reluctant Wishes
rows.description: A rugged rock resembling a stone of controlling earth elementals that grants wishes based on the holder's Charisma, but acts merely as a stone of weight on a failed attempt.

rows.name: Bottle of the Bound
rows.description: An ancient brass bottle that traps a fiendish army; a holder who knows the command words can use it like a summon monster IX spell at will, summoning only evil-subtype creatures.

rows.key: Cloud Castle of the Storm King
rows.name: Cloud Castle of the Storm King
rows.description: A grand floating fortress held aloft and propelled by storm clouds rumbling with thunder and crackling with lightning, able to house up to 300 Medium creatures and grant its master various weather-related spell-like abilities.

rows.name: Fork of the Forgotten One
rows.description: A magical ranseur that once belonged to an archdevil, granting bonuses to Diplomacy and Intimidate checks and a scorching ray ability; any nonevil creature that touches it must become lawful evil immediately or die.

rows.name: The Moaning Diamond
rows.description: An uncut diamond that produces a constant moaning sound; three times per day its bearer can reshape earth and stone as if by stone shape, affecting a large volume of material.

rows.name: The Shield of the Sun
rows.description: A +5 shield that grants paladin spellcasting ability and spell resistance; a chaotic or evil character wielding it gains four negative levels for as long as they possess it.

rows.name: Staff of Bolstering
rows.description: A rosewood staff bound with metal rings, granting bear's endurance, bull's strength, cat's grace, and greater magic weapon.

rows.name: Staff of Cackling Wrath
rows.description: A gnarled, thorn-covered staff granting blindness/deafness, charm person, hold person, and inflict moderate wounds, plus baleful polymorph, bestow curse, and vampiric touch.

rows.name: Staff of Hoarding
rows.description: A teak staff studded with gold and silver coins, granting identify, locate object, magic aura, secret chest, and legend lore.

rows.name: Staff of Journeys
rows.description: A dark gray-barked walking stick forked at the top, granting detect snares and pits, endure elements, longstrider, pass without trace, and freedom of movement.

rows.name: Staff of Many Rays
rows.description: A white wooden staff with swirls of shining metal, granting ray of enfeeblement, ray of exhaustion, scorching ray, enervation, and disintegrate.

rows.name: Staff of Obstacles
rows.description: A worn stone-like staff that is surprisingly light, granting arcane lock, grease, wind wall, wall of fire, wall of ice, and wall of stone.

rows.name: Staff of Performance
rows.description: A varnished cedar staff that grows ornamental keys and strings to resemble its owner's favorite instrument, granting calm emotions, glibness, hypnotic pattern, pyrotechnics, enthrall, major image, and sculpt sound.

rows.name: Staff of Revelations
rows.description: A forked walnut staff resembling a dowsing rod, granting augury, speak with dead, divination, and commune.

rows.name: Staff of Rigor
rows.description: An iron-shod black staff granting bane, cause fear, command, magic weapon, and align weapon.

rows.name: Staff of Slumber
rows.description: A staff with a smoky, almost hypnotic spiral pattern, granting deep slumber, ray of exhaustion, dream, nightmare, waves of fatigue, and symbol of sleep.

rows.name: Staff of Shrieking
rows.description: A metal staff with holes that make it emit an eerie moan when swung, granting shatter, sound burst, and shout.

rows.name: Staff of Souls
rows.description: An ominous-looking staff granting deathwatch, detect undead, gentle repose, speak with dead, and death ward.

rows.name: Staff of Stealth
rows.description: A twisted, dark gray staff granting disguise self, invisibility, nondetection, and greater invisibility.

rows.name: Staff of Toxins
rows.description: A hemlock-shrouded oak staff giving off a faint whiff of rot, granting stinking cloud and cloudkill.

rows.name: Staff of Traps
rows.description: A dark wooden staff tipped with chalk-like stone, granting alarm, magic mouth, phantom trap, explosive runes, fire trap, and sepia snake sigil.

rows.name: Staff of Vision
rows.description: A brass staff topped with a clear crystal lens, granting arcane eye, arcane sight, see invisibility, prying eyes, scrying, and true seeing.

rows.name: Staff of Weather
rows.description: A carved oaken staff depicting weather opposite the current conditions, granting fog cloud, gust of wind, wind wall, ice storm, sleet storm, and control weather.

rows.name: Rod of Arson
rows.description: A cursed rod, disguised as a rod of flame extinguishing, that instead channels flame into its wielder's body, compelling them to set flammable objects alight or take fire damage resisting the urge.

rows.name: Jailer's Ring
rows.description: A ring that keeps its wearer constantly aware, status-like, of any linked prisoner's ring wearers, letting the jailer scry or teleport to them.

rows.name: Prisoner's Ring
rows.description: A cursed ring that, once placed on a subject by a jailer's ring wearer, cannot be removed by the wearer without powerful magic.

rows.name: Ring of Arcane Signets
rows.description: A plain copper ring whose amorphous crystal setting forms into a specific rune or sigil the first time each wearer puts it on, letting them stamp that mark onto objects.

rows.name: Ring of Delayed Doom
rows.description: A ring set with garnets that lets its wearer delay a harmful saving-throw effect by destroying a garnet, for up to nine total one-minute delays.

rows.name: Ring of Forcefangs
rows.description: A ring that negates force spells targeted at its wearer and stores their energy as charges the wearer can later expend to cast magic missile offensively.

rows.name: Ring of Maniacal Devices
rows.description: A ring granting a +5 competence bonus on checks to build or disable traps and to use Disable Device, including untrained use.

rows.name: Ring of Retribution
rows.description: A ring that, once per day, detonates in a 30-foot radius dealing 10d6 points of fire damage.

rows.name: Cannibal Ring
rows.description: A cursed ring that appears to be a ring of sustenance but, after 7 days, causes constant hunger and thirst so severe the wearer is eventually driven to cannibalism.

rows.name: Ring of Truth
rows.description: A cursed ring that renders its wearer unable to tell a deliberate lie, in speech or writing, unless they succeed at a DC 20 Will save.

rows.name: All Tools Vest
rows.description: A light leather vest with many pockets that, once per day for 24 hours, summons the complete standard tools for any one Craft skill.

rows.name: Amulet of Magecraft
rows.description: A heavy silver necklace that functions as a universalist wizard's bonded object, letting its bearer spontaneously convert spells of their chosen school.

rows.name: Amulet of Spell Cunning
rows.description: A silver locket that functions as a wizard's bonded object, letting its bearer prepare three additional spell levels of spells each day.

rows.name: Annihilation Spectacles
rows.description: Darkly tinted glasses that let a transmuter spontaneously convert prepared spells into transmutation spells, or cast disintegrate once per day.

rows.name: Apple of Eternal Sleep
rows.description: A beautiful red apple that, if eaten, forces a DC 19 Will save or induces an eternal magical sleep requiring break enchantment to end.

rows.name: Assisting Gloves
rows.description: A simple glove that, on a spoken command word, transforms into a glowing disembodied hand; as a swift action the wearer can have the glove assist them with a task as if using the aid another action.

rows.name: Bandages of Rapid Recovery
rows.description: Linen bandages that let their user recover as if under complete bed rest regardless of activity, and grant a +4 bonus to effective character level when receiving long-term care.

rows.name: Book of the Loremaster
rows.description: A digest-sized book that grants a bard a +5 competence bonus, up to three times daily, when taking 10 or 20 on a Knowledge check.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Cold)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat cold terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Desert)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat desert terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Forest)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat forest terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Jungle)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat jungle terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Mountain)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat mountain terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Plains)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat plains terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Planes)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat planar terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Swamp)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat swamp terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Underground)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat underground terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Urban)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat urban terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain (Water)
rows.description: Supple leather boots letting a ranger treat water terrain as a favored terrain, granting a +2 bonus on the associated checks.

rows.name: Bottle of Messages
rows.description: A green glass bottle with a tiny winding key on its stem that, when turned, causes a shadowy cork to slowly become substantial over a round.

rows.name: Bracelet of Mercy
rows.description: A metal bracelet with holy inscriptions that grants, or improves, the diseased mercy for a paladin wearer.

rows.name: Campfire Bead
rows.description: A tiny glass bead that transforms, on command, into a 2-foot-tall pile of burning logs lasting 8 hours.

rows.name: Catching Cape
rows.description: A silvery cape that transforms into a protective sphere, granting 20% concealment against ranged attacks for one minute or until it absorbs a hit.

rows.name: Cauldron of Brewing
rows.description: A fine cooking pot that maintains liquids at a precise temperature and grants a +5 competence bonus on alchemy-related Craft checks.

rows.name: Cauldron of Flying
rows.description: An iron pot large enough for two Medium creatures that grants overland flight with a substantial carrying capacity.

rows.name: Cauldron of Plenty
rows.description: An enchanted iron pot that can produce nourishing food for 36 people daily, or a heroes' feast for 12 people weekly.

rows.name: Cauldron of Resurrection
rows.description: A heavy dark iron cauldron with a monstrous maw that can restore the dead when used alongside raise dead or resurrection spells.

rows.name: Cauldron of Seeing
rows.description: A small cauldron filled with liquid that functions as a scrying device, letting its user scry at any distance like a crystal ball.

rows.name: Cauldron of the Dead
rows.description: A dark iron cauldron capable of transforming corpses into zombies for a material cost per Hit Die of the resulting undead.

rows.name: Clamor Box
rows.description: A tin music box that, after a configurable delay of 1 to 20 minutes, produces sounds as loud as a crowd of forty people (battle, fire, massacre, or riot).

rows.name: Construct Channel Brick
rows.description: A red brick matching its bearer's holy symbol, letting the bearer channel positive or negative energy to repair constructs and damaged objects.

rows.name: Cowardly Crouching Cloak
rows.description: A gray hooded cloak that lets its wearer huddle into a crouch, granting a sanctuary effect (Will save negates) while rendering the wearer effectively blind.

rows.name: Crystal of Healing Hands
rows.description: A prism worn on a cord that stores a paladin's lay on hands energy for later release as a standard action.

rows.name: Defoliant Polish
rows.description: A gray paste coated on armor that produces fumes causing natural plants to wilt, letting the wearer move through vegetation without difficulty.

rows.name: Doomharp
rows.description: A bone-and-sinew masterwork harp that lets a non-bardic user perform the dirge of doom bardic performance.

rows.name: Dust of Emulation
rows.description: A glittering golden dust that grants an automatic result of 25 on a Use Magic Device check made to emulate a class feature for 1 hour.

rows.name: Flying Ointment
rows.description: An herbal preparation that, applied to the skin, grants overland flight for up to 9 hours.

rows.name: Gloves of Dueling
rows.description: Supple leather gloves granting a +4 bonus to CMD against disarm and sunder attacks, plus a weapon training bonus.

rows.name: Glowing Glove
rows.description: A white leather glove that creates luminous handprints, glowing in any chosen color and lasting a day, on surfaces it touches.

rows.name: Grappler's Mask
rows.description: A dark leather mask covering the head and upper body, letting its wearer attempt bull rushes and grapples without provoking attacks of opportunity.

rows.name: Helm of Fearsome Mien
rows.description: A metal helm shaped like a fearsome predator, letting a barbarian use the intimidating glare rage power while raging.

rows.name: Horn of the Huntmaster
rows.description: A curved horn that, once per day for a minute, lets a hunter grant their full favored enemy bonus to allies within 30 feet.

rows.name: Ioun Torch
rows.description: A burned-out, dull gray ioun stone bearing a continual flame spell; it still floats and orbits its bearer, letting them carry light while keeping both hands free.

rows.name: Key of Lock Jamming
rows.description: A brass key that reshapes to fit standard keyholes, merging with a lock to make it unopenable while adding to its hardness and hit points.

rows.name: Ki Mat
rows.description: A woven river-reed mat that lets a monk regain ki points through meditation using a Wisdom check.

rows.name: Knight's Pennon (Battle)
rows.description: A red cloth flag mounted on a weapon that, once per day, grants heroism to its bearer.

rows.name: Knight's Pennon (Honor)
rows.description: A gold cloth flag mounted on a lance that, once per day, grants its bearer a protection from evil effect.

rows.name: Knight's Pennon (Parley)
rows.description: A white cloth flag that, for one hour, grants a +4 enhancement bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks.

rows.name: Lord's Banner (Crusades)
rows.description: A noble cloth flag emitting a hallow effect in a 40-foot radius for true believers of the religion it depicts.

rows.name: Lord's Banner (Swiftness)
rows.description: A cloth flag that lets a traveling force make forced marches without Constitution checks or nonlethal damage.

rows.name: Lord's Banner (Terror)
rows.description: A cloth flag that panics enemies within 30 feet who can see it, unless they succeed at a Will save.

rows.name: Lord's Banner (Victory)
rows.description: A cloth banner that grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks to visible allies.

rows.name: Manacles of Cooperation
rows.description: Iron cuffs that render a restrained humanoid docile and compliant through enchantment.

rows.name: Mask of Giants (Lesser)
rows.description: A wooden mask that lets a wild shape user assume a giant humanoid's form, granting some of that giant's abilities.

rows.name: Mask of Giants (Greater)
rows.description: An enhanced wooden mask that lets a wild shape user assume a giant humanoid's form with additional abilities, including rend, regeneration, and rock throwing.

rows.name: Moon Circlet
rows.description: A silver circlet that grants darkvision and adjusts an arcane caster's effective caster level based on the current lunar phase.

rows.name: Muleback Cords
rows.description: Thick leather cords that treat the wearer's Strength score as 8 higher for determining carrying capacity only, never applying to combat or other Strength-related rolls.

rows.name: Necklace of Ki Serenity
rows.description: A knotted leather cord granting a +4 bonus to effective character level for ki pool calculations.

rows.name: Necromancer's Athame
rows.description: A bone dagger that functions as a necromancer's bonded object, letting its bearer spontaneously convert prepared spells into necromancy spells.

rows.name: Philter of Love
rows.description: A potent preparation that causes a creature drinking it to fall madly in love with the first creature it perceives afterward.

rows.name: Robe of Arcane Heritage
rows.description: Dark purple and blue robes that treat a sorcerer's level as 4 higher for the purposes of bloodline powers.

rows.name: Sash of the War Champion
rows.description: A red cloth sash bearing crowd imagery that treats the wearer's fighter level as 4 higher for armor training and bravery class features.

rows.name: Scabbard of Stanching
rows.description: A red leather sheath with gold filigree that automatically stanches bleed effects below a set severity affecting the sheathed weapon's wielder.

rows.name: Scabbard of Vigor
rows.description: A scabbard that, once per day as part of drawing the weapon it holds, can endow that weapon with a temporary enhancement bonus.

rows.name: Sheath of Bladestealth
rows.description: A mundane-appearing sheath that renders a sheathed bladed weapon invisible until it is drawn.

rows.name: Silver Smite Bracelet
rows.description: A heavy silver bracelet etched with virtue icons that treats a paladin's level as 4 higher for smite evil.

rows.name: Sniper Goggles
rows.description: Bulbous lenses that let their wearer make ranged sneak attacks at any distance, gaining an extra +2 damage bonus within 30 feet.

rows.name: Soul Soap
rows.description: A gray soap bar that, after a minute of washing with it, lets a creature attempt a new Will save against a hostile mind-affecting effect.

rows.name: Torc of Lionheart Fury
rows.description: A heavy copper neckpiece bearing lion imagery that grants a +2 morale bonus on saves against fear.

rows.name: Vest of the Cockroach
rows.description: A red-brown padded vest that grants or enhances a rogue's resiliency talent, improving damage reduction.

rows.key: War Paint of the Terrible Visage
rows.name: War Paint of the Terrible Visage
rows.description: Face paint that lets the wearer rearrange its pigments into a disturbing visage as a swift action, affecting one visible creature within 30 feet with fear.

rows.name: Cloak of Immolation
rows.description: A cursed cloak that bursts into continuous flame the moment it is worn, dealing fire damage to the wearer each round without harming the cloak itself.

rows.name: Crown of Blindness
rows.description: A cursed silver circlet that forces a DC 14 Fortitude save or permanently blinds the wearer, requiring curse-removal magic to reverse.

rows.name: Hat of Hatreds
rows.description: A cursed hat that resembles a hat of disguise but instead causes its wearer to take on the appearance of whatever person or creature a nearby hostile creature most wants to harm.

rows.name: Girdle of Opposite Gender
rows.description: A cursed magical belt that, once put on, forces a DC 20 Fortitude save or transforms the wearer into a person of the opposite gender.

rows.name: Riot Pipes
rows.description: Cursed musical pipes that force everyone within hearing to succeed at a DC 15 Will save or fall into a murderous rage-like fury for 1d6 hours.

rows.name: Brooch (Folding Plate)
rows.description: The brooch form of folding plate armor, which transforms between a wearable brooch and a suit of +1 full plate armor on command.
